title: Cantilever column with axial and lateral load: second-order base moment - values printed by the vendor that do not reproduce

source.work: Bentley Systems, STAAD.Pro Help, Verification Examples (public documentation, docs.bentley.com)
source.edition: STAAD.Pro Help v21 build (pages refer to the STAAD.Pro 2023 sample files), read 2026-11-22
source.notes: problem statement taken from the vendor page (text and input listing). The page cites: no textbook; the page validates with M = H L + P x (first-order tip deflection) - NOT opened for this project; no number is taken from it. The page's 'theory' values are recorded as printed; the program's own results are not used.

analysis: Plane problem in the global X-Y plane (Y vertical); the out-of-plane DOFs (uz, rx, ry) of every node are held; in-plane bending about local z. Cantilever column of 144 in, built in at the base, free at the top; W8x10 with the moment of inertia the page uses, I = 30.80 in^4, E = 29,000 ksi; axial load 3 kip and lateral load 5 kip at the top. Combination 'second': second-order analysis of both loads (the engine's member carries the exact stability functions); combination 'first': first-order analysis of the lateral load alone. The area does not enter the targets (placeholder 10 in^2); Iy = 1000 Iz so that no out-of-plane buckling enters.  Same model as problem 'cantilever-column-p-delta' (whose recomputed targets are active); the targets here are the vendor's printed values only.

targets.precisionNote: printed "736.72"; tolerance = half a unit in the last printed digit; the page's reference base moment (its table header says ft kip; the value is in kip in)
targets.sign: the page prints a magnitude; sign from the reference solution, engine convention (docs/CONVENTIONS.md)

quarantine.diagnosis: Missed by 6.4e-4 relative: engine 737.194 kip in, printed 736.72. The page's reference is a one-step approximation, M = H L + P x (FIRST-order tip deflection) = 5 x 144 + 3 x 5.57; the exact second-order solution of the stated beam-column (ODE oracle) is M = 737.194 kip in with a tip deflection of 5.731 in. The approximation omits the growth of the deflection under the axial load (P / P_e = 0.028). The page's first-order tip deflection 5.57 in reproduces and is a target of the active problem.
